BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-VinaGridBox
BundleInfo.Author: Ayan Bhowmik
BundleInfo.Synopsis: Visualize, inspect, and export AutoDock Vina search-space center and size values in ChimeraX.
BundleInfo.Description:
ChimeraX Vina Grid Box is a ChimeraX bundle for defining and inspecting an AutoDock Vina search space directly on a molecular structure. It visualizes Vina center_x/center_y/center_z and size_x/size_y/size_z values as a 3D box, can derive a padded selection bounding box (recommended for receptor pockets) or a Vina-style ligand-centroid box (for ligand-only compatibility checks) from selected atoms, reports exact Cartesian bounds, and copies a Vina-ready configuration block. The optional rounded map-extent display illustrates the voxelized span implied by Vina's grid spacing without changing the exported size values.
The stable release excludes experimental drag-resize controls. Center and size are edited numerically in the GUI or with the vinabox command. For selection-derived boxes, the recommended method is an axis-aligned minimum/maximum bounding box with padding added to every side. A second, explicitly ligand-oriented option mirrors Vina’s ligand-centroid box calculation. The bundle does not perform docking or ligand/receptor preparation.
Author and maintainer: Ayan Bhowmik (ayan.bhowmik.bd@gmail.com). Coding and debugging were carried out with assistance from ChatGPT (OpenAI).
